Decision: readiness failed. Task readiness: FAIL; audit readiness: FAIL.

Cell annotations: metric/assigned; V=valid count, C=cap hits. An outlined cell with ! fails its frozen gate.
Diagnostics require≥11 correct,12 valid and0 caps; choices require≥23 valid and0 caps. All observations remain included.
S +0.5/+1.0 are multiples of the frozen full corpus-A contrast norm, not state or score units.
Passing these small cells does not establish noninferiority, unchanged confidence, psychological specificity or inner experience.
